meta.title: Three bids: award a three-way split 4 / 3 / 3 to B, C and A; approver rejects
gaps: The prepared event has exactly one bid rather than the requested three bids with A, B, and C at 100, 90, and 95 for 10 units.
Enter and verify the three-way allocation of 4 units to B, 3 to C, and 3 to A, including the per-vendor amounts and total 945.
Create and submit the proposal after filling its required fields; no catalog step independently performs this proposal workflow from the awarding screen.
Sign in as the approver and reject the proposal with a remark.
Assert that no purchase order is created after rejection.
Verify the buyer can start awarding again after the proposal is rejected.
